goal: Create a grounded photorealistic working portrait of one fictional adult ceramic artist shaping a small bowl at a wheel.
audience: Editorial art directors seeking believable, non-glamour people-and-process imagery

content.subject: One fictional 36-year-old adult ceramic artist working naturally at a small electric potter's wheel in a daylight studio
must_include: Complete seated body from head to both shoes
Both complete hands and all ten plausible fingers shaping one small centered clay bowl
Visible bowl-to-wheel contact and credible working posture
Unbranded modest workwear with clay dust
A quiet used ceramics workshop with natural window light
must_avoid: Malformed fingers, warped bowl, or cropped joints
Fashion campaign, product shot, beauty retouching, or influencer pose
Visible text, brands, logos, or watermarks
Collage, illustration, cartoon, or anime styling

art_direction.style: Photorealistic observed craft documentary with quiet natural texture
art_direction.lighting: Soft north-window daylight with broad reflected fill and restrained shadows

composition.layout: Vertical full-body workspace portrait with hands and one small forming bowl as the primary focus
composition.viewpoint: Eye-level 55 mm documentary perspective at an observed working distance

objective_checks: Output is exactly 864x1821 PNG/RGB without alpha
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Hands, fingers, wheel contact, bowl, and seated anatomy are complete and plausible
Wardrobe is modest, unbranded, and materially consistent with a working studio
Skin, clay, textile, wood, plaster, and daylight read as natural photography
The image is distinct from a static portrait, fashion lookbook, motion editorial, or character-design sheet
